detail.longDescription: 🚀 Version 1.0.0 is here! We've historically been using the latest commit and docker image, but we didn't have a proper release management process or changelog. From now on, changes will not be released as soon as a PR is merged. Instead, we will periodically pack groups of changes in a release, with a changelog, git tags, and docker tags. We hope this makes it easier to manage self-hosted instances, as well as to learn about the latest changes. # foss # opensource # selfhosted # selfhosting
